_note: PvE AI tuning (PvE AI & Encounters). Per-kind attack numbers stay in abominations.json; this file holds how creatures hunt. Distances in metres, times in seconds, turn rates in radians per second. Behaviour briefs: docs/gdd/pve-ai.md.

awareness._note: Awareness fills 0..1. At suspicious the creature turns and investigates the stimulus; at 1 it hunts. Sight fill per second = sightRate * visibility * (1 - distance/range); peripheral (outer half of the field of view) fills at peripheralFactor. A noise adds noiseGain scaled by how far inside its radius the creature is. Awareness decays at decayRate while nothing is sensed.

light._note: Host visibility multiplies sight range and sight fill. Gunfire flashes the host for flashTime. Footprint glow (Plague-Stalker) multiplies on top via the virus cost.

tokens._note: At most `melee` creatures attack the host at once; the rest circle at ringRadius and feint. Keeps fights readable.

nestSpawn._note: Creatures pulsed out of a nest are flung outward and start hunting the host at once.

menace._note: What makes hunters frightening (docs/gdd/pve-ai.md, Menace). reaction: seconds a creature that spots the host itself stands still and stares before it comes (alerted packmates skip it). search: a cold trail is chased to where the host was heading (velocity x predictTime, at most maxPredict m), and each searcher checks its own spot within spread m, sweeping sweepTime s before trying the next. ambush: after a chase that went cold, swarm and stalker hunters may crouch where they lost the host instead of going home, springing at range m, giving up after time s. wounded: below limpBelow Biomass a creature moves at limpFactor; on first dropping below fleeBelow it runs for fleeTime s with fleeChance, then calls its pack and returns. dodge: swarm and flyer hunters inside the host's aimCone (degrees, full width) within range m juke sideways at speed m/s with chance when a shot (a noise of at least minNoise m radius at the host) goes off, at most once per cooldown s, never mid wind-up or lunge.

warden._note: The Warden of the Long Seed (src/ai/warden.ts); attack numbers stay in bosses.json `warden`. wake.trigger: 'approach' (a host enters the reactor chamber or comes within radius m) until Gameplay's ship-power objective exists, then 'power'. It crawls walls and ceiling at crawlSpeed in tend, re-perching every perchTime s; later phases hold holdDistance m on the floor at floorSpeed. The root spear reaches spearRange m and lands where the host was heading (velocity x spearLead s), hitting within spearRadius m. A vented valve opens its seam for seamOpenTime s. Tells for attacks bosses.json gives no wind-up: steamTell, birthTell. Enraged, the reactor pulses every enragePulseEvery s.

mimic._note: Husk Mimic: walks up at walkFactor x its speed like a host until revealDistance (abominations.json), then an unmaskTell s rear-and-shriek, a lungeTime s lunge, recoverTime s, then hunts at full speed.

grazer._note: Lumen Grazer: idles at idleHeight m; panicking, it hangs at diveFrom m over a host within tellRange m through its wind-up, dives at diveSpeed m/s and slams at slamHeight m (abominations.json damage within attackRange), then climbs for climbTime s.

weaver._note: Tithe Weaver: hovers at hoverHeight m, strings a strand every spinEvery s (twice as often hunting, cutAhead m ahead of a running host), keeps keepRange m away and spits.
